text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Forum on Moslem-Croat Federation agreed to establish Sarajevo cantonal authorities and new cantonal police by end of February.

- Muhamed Sacirbey, Bosnia's ambassador to United Nations, forwarded to president of Security Council a statement in which he demands further immediate measures to be undertaken regarding return of refugees to village Gajevi which has been permanently obstructed by Bosnian Serb authorities.
- A 167th brigade of the Moslem-Croat federal army is first one to complete 12-week training course within U.S.-backed "Train and Equip" programme.
- Bosnian Serb police due to enter Jusici, disputed village in eastern Bosnia, accompanied by international police forces IPTF and NATO-led Stabilisation Force (SFOR).
